### [`speed_by_lawn_number`](../../../../src/actors/actor_speed_setup.asm#L23) `$9042`

*label*

Lawns 1-16. LDX does not change A, so A is 0 here and $94bd returns 0. Thus the loyalty period $60 is always 6.
